metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 IGES CLI in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with build config in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt).

It builds with:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

Verified:

```bash
cmake --build build
./build/iges write --input /tmp/line.json --output /tmp/line.igs
./build/iges parse --input /tmp/line.igs --output /tmp/line.out.json
./build/iges eval --input /tmp/line.igs --de 1 --t 0.5 --output /tmp/line.eval.json
./build/iges roundtrip --input /tmp/line.igs --output /tmp/line.rt1.igs
./build/iges roundtrip --input /tmp/line.rt1.igs --output /tmp/line.rt2.igs
cmp -s /tmp/line.rt1.igs /tmp/line.rt2.igs
```

The smoke test produced 80-column IGES lines, parsed/queryable JSON, midpoint eval `[5,0,0]`, and byte-identical second round-trip output.
